word_order: other, because main clauses show V2 (roughly SVO) as in "Achtzehn Prozent ... sind arbeitslos", while subordinate and relative clauses are verb-final SOV as in "der ... gegangen war" or "dass ... werden sollte".
register: formal written prose / newswire / encyclopedic (news reports and encyclopedic-style sentences)
notes_for_prompt_writer: Prefer to emit segments at clear clause-connectors (coordinators like und/aber/oder or the subordinating complementizer dass) when they introduce an independent clause. Avoid finalizing a unit immediately after determiners or short prepositions (der/die/das, zu, im, am) because the following tokens will typically complete noun phrases or flip the reading. In subordinate/relative clauses expect verb-final placement — hold segmentation decisions until you see the clause's verb or sentence punctuation unless a coordinating connector makes an independent clause clear.
